$comment: HAR-1576 — legitimate text characters the glyph guard (glyph-icons.mjs) would flag. Each entry is text, not an icon, and says why. Keys name one occurrence (file::rule::glyph#n, the n-th in that file), so a new glyph in an allowed file still fails. This list may only shrink: an entry that matches nothing fails as stale.
